cursor.description: Draw Milagre's agent cursor and the current step on the screen while an agent acts.

gatewayUrl.description: The gateway in use: the saved one, else the one this Mac's agent-device or Simlock worker points at.

selector.description: A CSS selector that finds it again on the page.

label.description: How a person names it: `<PayButton> button "Pay now"`.

html.description: Its outer HTML, cut short, with secret-looking values redacted.

styles.description: The computed styles that matter for layout and look.

box.description: Where it sits in the viewport, in CSS pixels, and the viewport's size.

components.description: Its React components, innermost last, when the page is a React development build.

source.description: Its component's source location (`src/Checkout.tsx:88`), when the page exposes it.

point.description: Where on it the user clicked, as fractions of its box: the comment's pin goes there.

tab.description: On an Artifact page split into tabs: the tab it was pinned on.

format.description: Older transcript entries have no format; resolve them through the host's catalog.

group.description: The part of the app a design belongs to; the canvas lays out one row per group.

issueWorkspace.description: The Linear workspace the issue was picked from.

stopAfterDays.description: An off rule keeps its number, so turning it back on restores it.

retentionHours.description: How long a Chat stays in the Done list before the host archives it; 0 is never.

signingSecret.description: Webhook Routines: a new HMAC secret (write-only, never read back) and the header the signature comes in (null or blank: the default).
Webhook Routines: the HMAC secret, write-only (signs the Routine), and the header the signature comes in.

prompt.description: What the agent is sent: the body with the attached files listed.

sessionId.description: The chat to send to, or null for a new chat in the worktree.

body.description: The message as the chat shows it.

files.description: Paths of the files attached to the message.

fastMode.description: Claude only: faster Opus output at premium usage rates.

replies.description: How long Claude's replies run; Claude only, Codex ignores it.

tldrEnabled.description: Apply bundled TLDR writing rules to both providers. Defaults to true.

prAction.description: A PR-blocker pill's action. Milagre checks it and writes the body, prompt and context itself, ignoring the ones sent.

linearIssue.description: The first message of a Chat started from an issue. Milagre reads the issue and writes the body, prompt and context itself.

compact.description: Compact the Chat's context now (Claude only). Milagre writes the body, prompt and context itself, ignoring the ones sent.

sentFrom.description: Where the user typed it, when not in the Chat's own computer's window. The agent is told (packages/core/src/sent-from.cjs).

dataUrl.description: Draft and legacy images use dataUrl; persisted images use path.

sourcePath.description: Original file attachment when path points at the durable image copy.

files.description: Paths of the files attached to the message.

replies.description: How long Claude's replies run; Claude only, Codex ignores it.

title.description: A name the user gave the chat.

unread.description: A turn ended while the chat wasn't open, or the user marked it unread.

pinned.description: Shown in the chat list's Pinned section, above the rest, in `pin_order`.

pin_order.description: Where a pinned chat sits among the pinned ones, lowest first. Kept when unpinned; only read while pinned.

done.description: Marks the chat Done (the host stamps `done_at` with its own clock) or reopens it.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the days are cut in; the host's own when absent or unknown.

days.description: Days picked on the calendar ("2026-10-16"), both included; they replace `range`. One day reads by the hour.

byteLength.description: Read-only. The length of the ArrayBuffer (in bytes).

slice.description: Returns a section of an ArrayBuffer.

maxByteLength.description:
If this ArrayBuffer is resizable, returns the maximum byte length given during construction; returns the byte length if not.

[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/ArrayBuffer/maxByteLength)

resizable.description:
Returns true if this ArrayBuffer can be resized.

[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/ArrayBuffer/resizable)

resize.description:
Resizes the ArrayBuffer to the specified size (in bytes).

[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/ArrayBuffer/resize)

detached.description:
Returns a boolean indicating whether or not this buffer has been detached (transferred).

[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/ArrayBuffer/detached)

transfer.description:
Creates a new ArrayBuffer with the same byte content as this buffer, then detaches this buffer.

[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/ArrayBuffer/transfer)

transferToFixedLength.description:
Creates a new non-resizable ArrayBuffer with the same byte content as this buffer, then detaches this buffer.

[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/ArrayBuffer/transferToFixedLength)
